items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: Bobby Burst, who was a sergeant at Camp Holabird, was crossed from me. He and I got to be good friends

ctx.x: So your ability to read and write well kept you from combat.

From combat. From combat. Yeah. And I got into special services, and it's true they had guys look like giants, taller than me, and big guys couldn't read or write, came out of Georgia, came out of Alabama, came out of Florida, they came from all over, whites and blacks, the whites had their problems too. See, because Bobby Burst, who was a sergeant at Camp Holabird, was crossed from me.
